data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a gross release of US$34.9 million in prior year claims reserves, indicating favourable claims development across underwriting years prior to 2016. No specific causes or events were detailed for this release. The Syndicate also incurred US$56.0 million in major losses during 2016 from events including Alberta wildfires, Louisiana floods, Hurricane Matthew, Japan earthquake, Houston floods, and Gatlinburg wildfires.

data.data_quality_notes: The explicit prior year development figure of -US$34.9m from the 'Claims outstanding' note is used. This differs from a calculation based on the gross claims development triangle, which would yield -US$19.1m for years prior to 2015. The explicit line item is considered more authoritative for the overall prior year movement. No specific causes for the prior year release were provided in the document.
